words.sense: Broad agreement reached by members of a group on a shared decision.
misconceptions: Treating one person’s permission as group-wide agreement.

words.sense: Permission or approval given by a person for an action affecting them.
misconceptions: Assuming a majority decision gives permission on behalf of everyone affected.

semantic_axes.description: Consensus is a group’s broadly shared decision; consent is an individual’s permission or agreement to a proposed act.

edges.boundary_rule: Consensus is a group’s broadly shared decision; consent is an individual’s permission or agreement to a proposed act.
clues_b: individual can say yes or no

misconceptions.M1: Treating one person’s permission as group-wide agreement.
misconceptions.M2: Assuming a majority decision gives permission on behalf of everyone affected.
misconceptions.M3: Confusing people accepting a shared plan with authorizing use of something personal.
